context:
The pipeline-widening item is the enabling dependency; this item
is pure frontend wiring on top of the widened MetaRank. Extend in
place rather than introducing a sibling MasterLeaderboard component
(per plan) since the data shape already carries everything
needed. Reuse chartMath.colorForCell and QueryHeatmap's a11y
pattern - no new primitives. Default render mode on first visit:
Times, so the user immediately sees absolute values (the missing
surface this phase exists to restore).
description:
Phase B of the Results Explorer strategy revision
(plans/purring-jingling-petal-ultraplan).

Replace the current Home page's rank-only `MetaLeaderboard` with a
ClickBench-style Platform × Cohort matrix of absolute values, with
toggles for Ranks and Speedup-vs-cohort-best, chip-based filters
(benchmark family, SF, phase, tuning, trust tier, date window), and
URL-synced state so views are shareable.

The "Recent Results" list stays (or moves below the matrix) - the
gap being filled is the lack of a cross-benchmark, cross-platform
high-level view with absolute values. This is the first thing a
user should see.

Depends on:
  - explorer-pipeline-meta-leaderboard-widening (MetaRank must carry
    metric_value, speedup_vs_best, primary_metric, primary_order)
  - explorer-url-synced-filter-state (useUrlState hook)

anti_patterns.dont: fork MetaLeaderboard into a separate component
anti_patterns.why: the shapes are the same post-widening
colorForCell is the shared log-scale palette

anti_patterns.dont: push filter state to a global store

preserves.behavior: Existing MetaLeaderboard consumers (if any outside Home) continue to work - render-mode toggle defaults to current behavior (Ranks)
Recent Results data surface remains accessible on Home (just demoted below the matrix)
colorForCell remains the single log-scale color source shared with QueryHeatmap - no duplicate palettes

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run typecheck && npm test
verifications.expected: all green, including MetaLeaderboard.a11y and filter wiring tests

/results/ shows master matrix; Times/Ranks/Speedup toggle works; applying benchmark + SF chips narrows columns/rows; URL round-trips; clicking a cohort header goes to /results/{benchmark}/?sf=X&phase=Y; row click goes to /results/p/{platform_id}/

work_units.notes:
results-explorer/src/components/MetaLeaderboard.tsx - extend in
place (per plan: data shape already carries what each mode needs
after the pipeline widening). Modes:
  - Times: metric_value formatted via fmtGeomean (asc) / fmtScore (desc)
  - Ranks: current behavior (rank / total)
  - Speedup: speedup_vs_best, cohort best = 1.0×
Log-scale color shading via existing colorForCell from
src/lib/chartMath.ts (single source of truth, shared with
QueryHeatmap).
work_units.summary: Extend MetaLeaderboard component with render-mode toggle (Times/Ranks/Speedup)

work_units.notes:
results-explorer/src/types.ts - add metric_value,
speedup_vs_best, primary_metric, primary_order to MetaRank.
All optional so the type survives older artifacts.
work_units.summary: Widen MetaRank frontend type in types.ts

work_units.notes:
Filters: Benchmark family (multi), SF (multi), Phase
(power/standard/throughput), Tuning mode, Trust tier, Date
window. Each backed by useUrlState with a suitable serde
(arraySerde for multis, stringSerde for singles).
Filter state feeds both the visible cohort columns and the
visible platform rows.
work_units.summary: Sticky filter chip row backed by useUrlState

work_units.notes:
results-explorer/src/pages/Home.tsx - make the matrix the
primary content surface. Do not wire cohort/row navigation yet
(w6 handles that). Do not change the Recent Results position
yet (w5 handles that). Scope: layout only.
work_units.summary: Scaffold Home.tsx around the extended MetaLeaderboard as primary content

work_units.notes:
Keep the Recent Results component and data surface; move its
render position below the matrix on Home.tsx. No behavioral
change to the list itself.
work_units.summary: Demote Recent Results list below the matrix

work_units.notes:
Cohort headers → /results/{benchmark}/?sf=X&phase=Y (preserve
the relevant slice of filter state via useUrlState's serde).
Row click → /results/p/{platform_id}/.
work_units.summary: Wire cohort header links and row-click navigation with preserved filter state

work_units.notes:
The new master matrix is structurally similar to QueryHeatmap -
reuse the same a11y scaffolding (role=grid, aria-rowindex/col,
roving tabindex). Existing tests like
QueryHeatmap.a11y should continue to pass; author a sibling
MetaLeaderboard.a11y test covering the equivalent contract.
work_units.summary: Accessibility: reuse QueryHeatmap's role=grid + roving tabindex pattern
Vitest coverage for render-mode toggle, filter→matrix wiring, cohort-link state preservation
